objective: Useful audience response and qualified visits

soc-calendar-standup.expected_when: The routine is due and its scoped report, research or reconciliation has not been verified for the period.
soc-calendar-standup.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
soc-calendar-standup.fallback: Reverify stale blockers, reconcile progress receipts and select the next authorized owned action. Surface delivery stalls separately from run failures.
soc-calendar-standup.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.

soc-draft-queue.expected_when: An owned feasible card, due commitment or scheduled deliverable exists. A blocked due commitment remains expected.
soc-draft-queue.acceptance: A usable reviewed artifact meets the card definition of done and proof requirements.
soc-draft-queue.fallback: Turn a sourced customer question into a distinctive hook, format or response draft within the existing queue cap.
soc-draft-queue.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
